notes: Run in an isolated slopsentral worktree and preserve any unrelated local files.
The benchmark may change only local files and must not publish or modify remote state.
Astra-targeted definition; static validation and golden replay are not a live model benchmark result.
setupQuestions: Which requested paths may be staged while unrelated work remains untouched?
Which repository-owned check proves the scoped local change?

scenarios.title: Dirty worktree scoped staging
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether Git preparation preserves unrelated work and proves the exact staged change set.
scenarios.userInput: Use Developer Tools in this isolated dirty worktree. Inspect all changes, stage only the requested validated files, and prove the staged diff is clean. Do not commit, push, open a pull request, or modify remote state.
successChecklist: The run records the initial dirty state before staging.
Only the requested paths enter the staged diff.
Unrelated tracked and untracked user work remains unchanged.
